def _parse_html_to_end(state: BlockState, end_marker: str, start_pos: int
    ) ->int:
    marker_pos = state.src.find(end_marker, start_pos)
    if marker_pos == -1:
        text = state.src[state.cursor:]
        end_pos = state.cursor_max
    else:
        end_of_marker = marker_pos + len(end_marker)
        # find the end of the line containing the end marker
        newline_pos = state.src.find('\n', end_of_marker)
        if newline_pos == -1:
            end_pos = state.cursor_max
        else:
            end_pos = newline_pos + 1
        text = state.src[state.cursor:end_pos]

    state.append_token({'type': 'block_html', 'raw': text})
    return end_pos
